lines.text: In 1976, the United States deployed an entire war armada... just to cut down a single tree.
It started when North Korean soldiers killed two American officers attempting to trim a poplar tree blocking the DMZ view.
Washington refused to back down. They launched Operation Paul Bunyan.
813 combat engineers and troops marched in. 27 helicopters circled above.
Behind them? Nuclear-capable B-52 bombers, fighter jets, and an aircraft carrier battle group stood ready.
North Korea watched in dead silence. In 42 minutes, the tree was gone. Zero bullets fired.
